name: landing_sites
_comment: HAND-CURATED. Planetocentric lat, east-positive lon (-180..180). Approximate (~0.1 deg) except where noted; good enough for labels, not for navigation.

properties.name: Viking 1
properties.origin: Lander. First successful long-duration Mars lander (Chryse Planitia).
properties.source: Mission landing coordinates (NASA / NSSDCA / mission publications), rounded

properties.name: Viking 2
properties.origin: Lander in Utopia Planitia; saw water frost in winter.
properties.source: Mission landing coordinates (NASA / NSSDCA / mission publications), rounded

properties.name: Mars 3
properties.origin: First soft landing on Mars; contact lost after ~20 s. Position approximate.
properties.source: Mission landing coordinates (NASA / NSSDCA / mission publications), rounded

properties.name: Mars Pathfinder / Sojourner
properties.source: Mission landing coordinates (NASA / NSSDCA / mission publications), rounded

properties.name: Spirit (MER-A)
properties.origin: Rover in Gusev crater; found hydrothermal silica deposits.
properties.source: Mission landing coordinates (NASA / NSSDCA / mission publications), rounded

properties.name: Opportunity (MER-B)
properties.origin: Rover in Meridiani Planum; drove 45 km over 14 years.
properties.source: Mission landing coordinates (NASA / NSSDCA / mission publications), rounded

properties.name: Phoenix
properties.origin: Lander in the northern plains; dug up and confirmed water ice just below the surface.
properties.source: Mission landing coordinates (NASA / NSSDCA / mission publications), rounded

properties.name: Curiosity (MSL)
properties.origin: Rover in Gale crater; only in-situ surface radiation measurements (RAD).
properties.source: Mission landing coordinates (NASA / NSSDCA / mission publications), rounded

properties.name: InSight
properties.origin: Lander in Elysium Planitia; seismometer (marsquakes) and heat probe.
properties.source: Mission landing coordinates (NASA / NSSDCA / mission publications), rounded

properties.name: Perseverance (Mars 2020)
properties.origin: Rover in Jezero crater delta; caching samples; carried the Ingenuity helicopter and MOXIE oxygen experiment.
properties.source: Mission landing coordinates (NASA / NSSDCA / mission publications), rounded

properties.name: Zhurong (Tianwen-1)
properties.origin: Chinese rover in southern Utopia Planitia.
properties.source: Mission landing coordinates (NASA / NSSDCA / mission publications), rounded
